quest.title: The Gardes' Inventor
quest.description: Two Gardes stop you. Just what are they doing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, what business do the Gardes have with us?

dialogues.speaker: Chenee
dialogues.text: Hehe. Why don't you take a guess?

choices.text: Is this about us flying around the city and scaling its walls?

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Ah, so you've done that too, have you? Hang on, let me add it to the list of charges.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you're trying to trick us!

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: No, I'm just joking. Introductions are in order, I suppose. I'm Chenee, and this is my senior, Frejus.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: My senior's come up with a new invention that needs testing. Would the two of you be interested in helping?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A new invention? What sort of thing is it?

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: A remote-controlled cannon.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: As you can see, earlier turret models require an operator nearby, in which case, an enemy just needs to aim at the cannon to get rid of both. But if such weapons can be controlled remotely...

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: That way, we can minimize casualties.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: You invented it so easily, too! I mean, that's why they call you "the Garde who rejected the Fontaine Research Institute's invitation three times"!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Three times rejected? The Institute?

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: Well...

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Exactly! Let me tell you, they had their eye on him, alright — they would've paid out the nose to have him do high-end research for 'em.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: But he's stayed all this time because he loves his work! Ah, such moving sentiment!

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Even so, he could not bear to let his talents go to waste, and so he creates new inventions from time to time to help with our work!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds awesome!

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: Ahem, you flatter me, Chenee. Do you still remember what I said before? The smarter you are, the more important it is to be humble.

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Yessir!

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: In any case, I'd like the two of you to help us verify the feasibility of this remote-controlled cannon. We've already prepped the "field" and the "targets," and rest assured that you will be well paid.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, in that case, you've come to the right adventurers!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The two of us have seen all sorts of stuff during our travels. We can help you figure out if your invention's good to go or not!

response.speaker: Chenee
response.text: Nice! In that case, good luck, all!

response.speaker: Frejus
response.text: Well... This way, if you would.

choices.text: Is this about me practicing swordplay in the city?
